senses.sense_definition: A romantic pairing of the characters Faith and Buffy Summers from the television series Buffy the Vampire Slayer

examples.text: Many fans write stories exploring the <w>Fuffy</w> relationship dynamic.
The <w>Fuffy</w> pairing remains a popular topic in online fan communities.

traits.comment: Used primarily within the Buffy the Vampire Slayer fandom

senses.sense_definition: The character Faith Lehane while inhabiting the body of Buffy Summers

examples.text: The episode where Faith swaps bodies is often referred to as the <w>Fuffy</w> arc.
Viewers were confused when <w>Fuffy</w> began acting completely out of character.

traits.comment: Used primarily within the Buffy the Vampire Slayer fandom
